diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-1 Construction of clutch
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional cutaway drawing showing the construction and major internal components of the assembled clutch unit on the flywheel, including diaphragm spring, pressure plate, disc, and release bearing sleeve.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: All dimensions indicated in mm (in). S30 2-seater uses C225S (225 mm OD); GS30 2+2 uses D240K (240 mm OD).

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-2 Supporting clutch assembly
diagrams.description: Illustration showing Clutch Aligning Bar KV30100100 inserted through the clutch disc hub and cover to support the assembly weight during removal and installation.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Insert alignment tool until fully seated to prevent disc damage when loosening cover bolts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-3 Measuring clutch lining
diagrams.description: Measurement of clutch lining wear using a depth gauge to measure depth from friction surface to rivet head.

callouts.Above 0.3 mm (0.012 in): Allowable minimum depth to rivet head

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Replace disc when facings are worn down to less than 0.3 mm (0.012 in) above rivet head.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-4 Repairing disc runout
diagrams.description: Clutch disc mounted on mandrel/lathe with dial gauge measuring runout at radius R, and bending tool used to correct runout.

callouts.R: Radius from hub center for runout inspection

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Never hold disc plate forcibly with pliers or bend excessively to avoid cracking facing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-5 Measuring the height of diaphragm spring
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional setup of clutch cover assembly mounted to Base Plate ST20050010 with Distance Piece ST20050100 and Set Bolts ST20050051 for measuring spring height A.
measurements_and_specs: Height A (C225S): 33 to 35 mm (1.30 to 1.38 in)
Height A (D240K): 37.5 to 39.5 mm (1.48 to 1.56 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure height A at several points around the fingers with vernier depth gauge.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-6 Adjusting spring height
diagrams.description: Technician using Diaphragm Spring Adjusting Wrench ST20050240 to pry and bend diaphragm spring fingers to uniform height.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Carefully pry fingers up or down to bring all tips within 0.5 mm height tolerance.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-7 Installing clutch cover assembly
diagrams.description: Installation cross-section of clutch disc and cover assembly onto flywheel using Clutch Aligning Bar KV30100100.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Keep disc facings, flywheel and pressure plate clean and dry.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-8 Removing clutch release mechanism
diagrams.description: View of the clutch housing interior showing removal of the release mechanism components.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect holder spring before withdrawing sleeve assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-9 Disassembling release bearing
diagrams.description: Technician using universal puller and adapter plates to pull the release bearing off the bearing sleeve.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Support bearing sleeve properly while pulling bearing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-10 Installing release bearing
diagrams.description: Press setup pressing release bearing onto sleeve, applying force only to inner race.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not press outer race. Press only on inner race.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-11 Lubricating recess of bearing sleeve
diagrams.description: Cross section of bearing sleeve indicating inner recess to be packed with multi-purpose grease.

callouts.Pack this recess: Inner annular grease recess in bearing sleeve

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pack inner groove lightly with multi-purpose grease.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-12 Lubricating points of withdrawal lever and front cover
diagrams.description: Diagram showing contact points on withdrawal lever fork ends, ball pin pivot socket, and transmission front cover nose to lubricate.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply very light coat of multi-purpose grease; avoid excess.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-13 Removing pilot bushing
diagrams.description: Removal of pilot bushing from rear crankshaft bore using Pilot Bushing Puller ST16610001 (Kent-Moore J 23907).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Expand puller jaws inside bushing and turn center bolt to extract.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-14 Installing pilot bushing
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional drawing showing the installation depth of the pilot bushing into the crankshaft bore.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bushing need not be oiled. Drive in squarely with a soft hammer/drift to specified depth.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-15 Clutch operating system
diagrams.description: Schematic diagram of the complete hydraulic clutch control linkage and operating system from pedal to clutch disc.
wiring_and_connections: Hydraulic line connecting master cylinder to operating cylinder
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Operating cylinder is non-adjustable; pedal depression directly actuates master cylinder and slave cylinder.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-16 Non-adjustable operating cylinder
diagrams.description: Internal cross-section of the non-adjustable clutch operating cylinder showing piston stroke and automatic compensation dimension S.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Non-adjustable design uses dimension S to self-adjust as clutch disc facing wears.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-17 Pedal height adjustment
diagrams.description: Side view schematic of clutch pedal linkage showing pedal height measurement b, free play a, lock nuts A and B, pedal stopper, and lubrication points.

callouts.a: Free play: 1.0 to 5.0 mm (0.039 to 0.197 in)

measurements_and_specs: Free play (a): 1.0 to 5.0 mm (0.039 to 0.197 in)
Lock nut A torque: 0.8 to 1.2 kg-m (5.8 to 8.7 ft-lb)
Lock nut B torque: 0.8 to 1.2 kg-m (5.8 to 8.7 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: First adjust pedal height with stopper bolt (lock nut A), then adjust free play with push rod (lock nut B). Measure free play on top face of pedal pad.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-18 Exploded view of clutch pedal
diagrams.description: Exploded view drawing of the clutch pedal assembly, fulcrum pin, bushings, return spring, and clevis connection.
measurements_and_specs: Fulcrum pin torque: 3.5 to 4.8 kg-m (25 to 35 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure pedal height from toe board before disassembly. Grease clevis pin friction surfaces.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-19 Exploded view of master cylinder
diagrams.description: Detailed exploded view of clutch master cylinder and internal valve components.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Never detach reservoir from cylinder body. Always renew rubber cups upon disassembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-20 Operating cylinder
diagrams.description: Operating cylinder mounted on clutch housing, connected to clutch hydraulic hose and withdrawal lever.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Keep clutch hose routed away from exhaust pipe.

diagrams.caption: Fig. CL-21 Exploded view of operating cylinder
diagrams.description: Exploded diagram of the clutch slave operating cylinder and internal components.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pay attention to cup direction when sliding over piston. Discard old cup and dust boot.

diagrams.caption: KV30100100 Clutch aligning bar
diagrams.description: Special service tool drawing of clutch aligning arbor KV30100100.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used to align and center clutch disc with pilot bushing and cover during assembly.

diagrams.caption: ST20050240 Diaphragm adjusting wrench
diagrams.description: Special service tool drawing of slotted diaphragm spring toe bending wrench ST20050240.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used to pry diaphragm spring fingers to uniform height.

diagrams.caption: ST20050100 Distance piece
diagrams.description: Special service tool drawing of ring distance pieces ST20050100 used for clutch cover height measurement.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Placed between clutch cover and base plate.

diagrams.caption: ST16610001 Pilot bushing puller
diagrams.description: Special service tool drawing of internal expanding collet pilot bushing puller ST16610001 (Kent-Moore J 23907).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Extracts pilot bushing from rear crankshaft bore without damaging crank.

diagrams.caption: ST20050010 Base plate
diagrams.description: Special service tool drawing of circular fixture base plate ST20050010.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Simulates flywheel surface when checking diaphragm spring height.

diagrams.caption: GG94310000 Flare nut torque wrench
diagrams.description: Special service tool drawing of flare nut torque wrench and crowfoot adapter GG94310000.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Prevents rounding and overtightening of hydraulic tube flare nuts.

diagrams.caption: ST20050051 Set bolts
diagrams.description: Special service tool drawing of stepped set bolts ST20050051 used to secure clutch cover to base plate.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Secures cover to base plate ST20050010.
